In [[7 BBY/Legends|7 BBY]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] '''annexed''' the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hargeeva]] after the discovery of [[Ore/Legends|mineral deposits]] in several [[Mountain/Legends|mountain]] ranges. A [[Arginall Garrison|garrison]] and [[Arginall Refinery|refinery]] were established on the planet, commanded by [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Nial Pedrin]]. The planet's [[High King]], [[Makintay]], was appointed as the planetary [[Governor/Legends|governor]].<ref name="Firepower">{{JournalCite|8|Firepower}}</ref>
